Petitioner is the 6th accused in C.C.No.1407 of 2014 of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-V,
Kozhikode, based on Annexure-A1 complaint alleging violation of the Food Safety and Standards
Act

. 
2. The matter relates to the quantity of iron fillings in the sample of tea taken.

Unknown vs By Advs.Sri.Madhu Radhakrishnan on 25 November, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48003658/
2

3. As per order dated 02.11.2017, the Director of the Food Regulatory Complaints Division, it has been ordered that all States/Union Territories are directed not to launch prosecutions for non-conformance of limit of iron fillings in cases, where samples were picked up/tested prior to 19.05.2016.
Over and above it, they are advised to withdraw all such prosecutions launched prior to 19.05.2016 either under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 or PFA Act, 1954.

Matters being so, all further proceedings as against the petitioner in C.C.No.1407 of 2014 of the Judicial First Class Magistrate's Court-V, Kozhikode, based on Annexure-A1 complaint are liable to be quashed.
